title: ReaComp：将LLM推理编译为符号求解器以实现高效程序合成
summary: 提出ReaComp方法，利用编码代理将少量LLM推理轨迹编译为可重用的符号程序合成器。测试时无需LLM调用，在PBEBench-Lite和Hard上分别达91.3%和84.7%准确率，超越LLM测试时扩展。与LLM搜索结合，准确率提升至85.8%并减少78% token使用。在历史语言学任务中零样本迁移达80.1%准确率。
summary_en: ReaComp compiles LLM reasoning traces into reusable symbolic program synthesizers via coding agents. Achieves 91.3% on PBEBench-Lite and 84.7% on PBEBench-Hard with zero LLM calls at test time, outperforming LLM test-time scaling by +16.3 points. Complements LLM search, improving accuracy to 85.8% while reducing token usage by 78%. Zero-shot transfers to historical linguistics with 80.1% accuracy.
